title: Mastrogiannopoulos and Anderson power Vikos Falcons to historic GBL promotion with Elite League Final Four triumph
description: Vikos Falcons made history on Sunday, becoming the first team from Ioannina â€” and the first from the Epirus region â€” to earn promotion to the Stoiximan Greek Basketball League (GBL), dismantling Evertech Papagou 87-72 in the Elite League Final Four championship game at the DAK Lefkadas. Sarandis Mastrogiannopoulos (194-PG-1997, agency: Octagon Europe) was the standout performer with 21 points, three rebounds, and eight assists in a commanding display, while Quincy Anderson (193-G-1999, college: Murray St.) matched him with 21 points and eight rebounds. The pair combined for 42 points as coach Thanasis Giaples's side took control early and never looked back.
imageCaption: Vikos Falcons wins GBL promotion with Elite League Final Four triumph (Photo: basket.gr)

title: Elite League Round 1 of Final Four. AO Mykonou clinch GBL promotion
description: Iraklis - Koroivos 79-58 Iraklis players were unselfish on offense dishing 21 assists. Nikos Paparegkas (200-1994) nailed 14 points and 9 rebounds for the winning side and forward Theodoros Gotzamanidis (200-2002) accounted for 16 points and 5 rebounds. Four Iraklis players scored in double figures. Power forward Aristotelis Sotiriou (203-2001, college: Adelphi) came up with 15 points and 6 rebounds and American point guard RJ Glasper (186-1998, college: UIW) added 8 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists respectively for Koroivos in the defeat. The winner was already known earlier in the game, so both coaches allowed to play the bench players saving starting five for next games.

title: Elite League Round 2 of Semi-Finals. Panionios edge Iraklis to clinch promotion
description: Iraklis - Panionios 70-75 Panionios held off Iraklis to clinch GBL promotion. 27 personal fouls committed by Iraklis helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The former international point guard Nikos Gkikas (186-1990, agency: Octagon Europe) had a double-double by scoring 23 points, 10 rebounds and 4 assists to lead the charge for the winners and point guard Iakovos Milentigievits (185-1997) chipped in 18 points and 7 rebounds during the contest. Panionios' coach Periklis Tavropoulos used a ten-player rotation in such tough game. Nikos Paparegkas (200-1994) responded with 18 points and 5 rebounds and American guard Sincere Carry (185-1999, college: Kent St.) scored 14 points and 5 assists. Four Iraklis players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Panionios Athens conquer Elite League trophy

title: Elite League Round 1 of Finals. Maroussi top AO Triton for the title
description: Forward Nikolaos Kamarianos (204-1997) nailed a double-double by scoring 16 points, 11 rebounds and 4 assists for the winning side and point guard Pavlos Xydas (185-1993) accounted for 14 points and 6 assists. Maroussi's coach Giorgos Skarafingas allowed to play the deep bench players in such tough game. Center Panagiotis Tsamis (204-2002) came up with 15 points and 9 rebounds and guard Kostas Koufopoulos (187-1999) added 18 points and 4 assists respectively for AO Triton in the defeat. Four AO Triton players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Maroussi top AO Triton for the title (Photo: eliteleague.gr)

title: A2 Round 3 of Finals. Psychiko earn title and gain promotion
description: Psychiko - Tritonas S. 80-52 Psychiko claimed A2 playoff title and secure the promotion. They overcame Trotinas in the decider to conquer the desired ticket. Psychiko outrebounded Tritonas S. 45-33 including 31 on the defensive glass. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 24 assists comparing to just 9 passes made by Tritonas S.'s players. It was a great evening for forward Nikolaos Papanikolaou (209-1985) who led his team to a victory with a double-double by scoring 10 points, 13 rebounds and 4 assists. Giannis Athanasoulas (202-1987) helped adding 17 points and 7 rebounds. The best for the losing side was Serbian guard Nemanja Manojlovic (197-1993, agency: Wasserman) with 17 points and 5 rebounds and guard Giannis Dimakos (192-1994) scored 6 points and 7 rebounds.
